title: Cream background, serif display and sage accent shipped together
evidence: background: #faf8f5 with font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif and .accent { color: #15573a } / .btn { background: #15573a }, plus the 4/3 .shot screenshot card to the right of the hero

title: Document head declares no viewport meta tag
evidence: <head> contains only <meta charset="utf-8"> and <title>Freight board</title>; there is no <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

title: Layout shell pinned to a fixed 1200px width
evidence: .shell { width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 64px 40px; } -- a fixed width, not a max-width, so the shell overflows every viewport under 1200px

title: Grid asserts three fixed 360px columns
evidence: .lanes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 360px); gap: 40px; } -- the column count is asserted rather than derived from available space

title: Frosted-glass sticky navigation bar verbatim
evidence: <nav class="backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 border-b sticky top-0">

title: Saturated neon glow box-shadow on the CTA
evidence: .cta { box-shadow: 0 0 40px 6px rgba(168,85,247,.6); } -- a 40px-spread halo in purple-500, decoupled from any dark-mode need

title: Icon wrapped in a tinted rounded-full container
Gradient clip-text applied to the hero heading
evidence: <h1 class="text-5xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 via-fuchsia-500 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">

title: Hero gradient stops sit in the AI purple arc
evidence: from-purple-600 via-fuchsia-500 to-blue-500 -- OKLCH hues 302.3, 322.1 and 259.8, the whole 255-325 purple-to-fuchsia arc used as the hero gradient

title: Cream page surface paired with serif display face
evidence: body { background: #faf8f5; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; } -- two of the three tasteful-default markers together

title: Vague SaaS-speak headline with no specific claim
evidence: Transform your workflow. Effortlessly.

title: unDraw flat-vector stock illustration as the hero asset
Refresh control has no behaviour behind it
evidence: <button onclick="/* TODO: wire refresh */">Refresh</button>

title: Invoice table ships the populated happy path only
evidence: <tbody> carries three rows, every one status Paid; the document has no empty, loading, error, overdue or long-value branch anywhere, and .status has only a .paid variant

title: Gradient clip-text on a single hero word
evidence: .accent { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.62 0.15 25), oklch(0.72 0.16 60)); background-clip: text; color: transparent; } applied to "reconciled" inside the h1

title: Unmodified shadcn Card primitive shipped verbatim
evidence: <div class="rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6"> -- the shadcn Card class string and its --card tokens, untouched

title: Both page containers repeat border, shadow and radius
evidence: <div class="shadow-sm hover:shadow-md border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4"> -- the second and only other container on the page reuses the same border + shadow-sm + rounded card treatment, with the arithmetic shadow-sm/shadow-md progression

title: Save button hardcodes a colour beside the brand token
evidence: .save { background: oklch(0.587 0.104 159); } and .save:hover { background: oklch(0.639 0.11 160); } beside the defined :root { --brand: oklch(0.49 0.085 158); }

title: Off-scale padding and radius bypass defined tokens
evidence: padding: 11px 17px; border-radius: 5px; on .save and margin-top: 9px; font-size: 13px on .hint, beside the defined --space-100: 4px / --space-200: 8px / --space-300: 12px and --radius: 6px

title: One 8px radius on every interactive control
evidence: border-radius: 8px on input/select/textarea (line 21), on .chip (line 25) and on button.submit (line 27) -- the shadcn --radius: 0.5rem default shared by every control; not classed in section 18, defaulted to MEDIUM

title: App shell sized with 100vh on a mobile surface
evidence: .app { height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } -- vh resolves against the large viewport, so the shell runs under mobile browser chrome

title: Bottom-pinned action bar ignores the safe-area inset
evidence: .bar { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; ... padding: 0.75rem 1rem; } with no env(safe-area-inset-bottom) on the padding and no viewport-fit=cover in the viewport meta

title: Card component laid out by a viewport media query
evidence: @media (min-width: 60rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; } } -- .firing renders both inside .rail (flex-basis clamp(14rem, 20vw, 18rem), about 224px) and inside the wide .main at the same viewport, so at 960px the rail copy gets a 144px label track beside roughly 80px of text
